_mo_ta: Tap cau nhu cau viet tay bang tieng Viet, dung huan luyen bo phan loai van ban TF-IDF + kNN (Mo hinh C). Moi nhan la mot NHOM NHU CAU/NGANH tuong ung voi mot ho so uu tien khac nhau. Nhom co the bo sung them cau that tu nguoi dung qua telemetry.

_nhan.LAP_TRINH: Cong nghe thong tin, lap trinh, chay may ao / docker
_nhan.DO_HOA: Thiet ke do hoa, dung phim, kien truc, chinh anh - can man mau chuan
_nhan.GAMING: Choi game, esport, giai tri nang
_nhan.DI_DONG: Di cong tac, kinh doanh, mang di nhieu - can nhe va pin trau
